title: 第一卷 第5章 想杀我的都出来第一卷 第6章 谁也走不了
lines: 秦绝来到一座府邸外。
青砖红瓦无苔痕，朱门之上，漆面光亮，一看便是翻新不久。
府外两名谢家护卫，看到秦绝走来，愣了愣神。
秦绝这张脸，让他们有几分熟悉感。
“麻烦二位进去通传一声，让谢家那些想杀我的人都出来一下。”秦绝淡淡开口道。
两名护卫，满脸错愕！
“你，你是何人！”一名护卫惊声问道。
他们瞬间意识到，眼前这位青年，若不是个来送死的，那便是来找麻烦的！
秦绝道：“秦家，秦绝！”
“秦绝！”
“那不是前准姑爷吗？难怪有点眼熟！”
二人神色一震！
“好，我们这就入内禀报！”
二人低吸一口气，转身快速进了谢府。
谢府内宅，谢家家主谢诚，正双眸微闭，手捻着灵玉珠串，坐等着谢云俊带回消息。
“算算时间，俊儿应该已经解决那小子了。”
“秦绝啊秦绝，你也莫怪我心狠，要怪就怪你自己，你既侥幸活了下来，就不该再回来！”
谢诚内心自喃时，急匆匆的脚步声，奔至堂外。
谢诚眉头一皱，冷冷的睁开眼眸，斥道：“何事如此慌张！”
“家主，秦绝来了！他让我们进来通禀一声，说让想杀他的人，都去府外……”护卫忙道。
谢诚瞳孔一张，猛地站起身子，怒声道：“这小子怎么可能还活着！大少爷呢！可曾看到？”
“未曾看到！”护卫忙道。
谢诚脸色一黑，哼声道：“真是废物东西，连这点小事都办不好！也罢，既然这小子自己送上门来了，那便让我亲自送他上路！”
谢诚哼了声，朝着堂外走去。
谢府外，秦绝没等多久，便见一道熟悉的身影，从府内走来。
四目遥对，没有昔年的亲近，只有冷到了骨子里的冰寒。
“怎么，在外面逃亡久了，连最起码的礼数都不懂了？”谢诚走到府门口，目色威严的哼声道。
秦绝唇角掀出一抹冷笑，不屑道：“你若是个好长辈，我自当敬你。只可惜，你不是，更不配。”
谢诚眼眸一眯，阴冷道：“想来是云俊他们太过张扬了，被你提前察觉，溜了出来。你若是个聪明的，就该逃出城去，不该来我府前送死。”
秦绝没有回答谢诚的问话，而是冷冷盯着谢诚问道：“谢云俊说，你要杀我，是因为我之前和谢云鸢有过婚约。我来这里，便是想当面向你问个明白，还有没有别的原因。”
谢诚眉头轻皱：“你见过云俊了？”
“见过。”秦绝淡淡道。
谢诚脸色微变：“那你怎么可能还活着？”
“你回答我的问题，我就回答你的问题！”秦绝冰冷道。
谢诚哼声道：“没错，我要杀你，就是因为你和鸢儿有过婚约！如今她已嫁为人妇，且身份尊贵。作为一个父亲，我自然不想让你这个有可能会给她带来麻烦的人，继续活在世上！”
秦绝点了点头，道：“你既如此轻贱我的性命，那也怪不得我心狠了。”
嗡！
秦绝右手一挥，谢云俊以及谢家那些宗师的尸体，尽数砸落在谢府大门前。
谢诚看到地上的尸体，脸色顿时煞白，瞳孔颤动，惊呼出声：“俊儿！”
content_en:
Qin Jue came outside a mansion.
The green bricks and red tiles have no moss marks, and the red door has a bright paint surface, which shows that it has been renovated recently.
The two Xie family guards outside the mansion were stunned when they saw Qin Jue approaching.
Qin Jue's face made them feel somewhat familiar.
"Can you two please go in and send a message to those in the Xie family who want to kill me?" Qin Jue said calmly.
The two guards looked astonished!
"You, who are you!" a guard asked in shock.
They instantly realized that if the young man in front of them was not here to die, then he was here to cause trouble!
Qin Jue said: "Qin family, Qin Jue!"
"Qin Jue!"
"Isn't that my former uncle-in-law? No wonder he looks familiar!"
The two of them looked shocked!
"Okay, let's go inside and report!"
The two took a deep breath, turned around and quickly entered Xie's mansion.
In the inner house of the Xie Mansion, the head of the Xie family, Xie Cheng, was sitting with his eyes slightly closed, twirling a string of spiritual jade beads, waiting for Xie Yunjun to bring back the news.
"Counting the time, Jun'er should have finished off that kid."
"Qin Jue, Qin Jue, don't blame me for being cruel. If you do, blame yourself. Since you were lucky enough to survive, you shouldn't come back!"
While Xie Cheng was muttering to himself, hurried footsteps rushed outside the hall.
Xie Cheng frowned, opened his eyes coldly, and scolded: "Why are you so panicked!"
"Master of the house, Qin Jue is here! He asked us to come in and make a report, telling everyone who wants to kill him to go outside the house..." the guard said hurriedly.
Xie Cheng's eyes widened, he stood up suddenly and said angrily: "How can this kid still be alive! Where is the young master! Have you ever seen him?"
"Never seen it!" the guard said hurriedly.
Xie Cheng's face turned dark and he snorted: "What a waste, he can't even handle such a small thing! Forget it, since this kid came to your door by himself, let me personally send him on his way!"
Xie Cheng snorted and walked out of the hall.
Outside Xie's mansion, Qin Jue didn't wait long before he saw a familiar figure walking from the mansion.
Their eyes were facing each other, there was no closeness like before, only the coldness to the bones.
"Why, you've been on the run for a long time, and you don't even understand the basic etiquette?" Xie Cheng walked to the door of the house and snorted with a majestic look.
A sneer appeared on Qin Jue's lips, and he said disdainfully: "If you were a good elder, I would respect you. It's a pity that you are not, let alone worthy of it."
Xie Cheng narrowed his eyes and said coldly: "I think Yun Jun and the others were too showy, and you noticed them in advance and slipped out. If you were smart, you should have escaped from the city and should not have come to die in front of my house."
Qin Jue did not answer Xie Cheng's question, but stared at Xie Cheng coldly and asked: "Xie Yunjun said that you want to kill me because I had a previous engagement with Xie Yunyuan. I came here to ask you in person if there are any other reasons."
Xie Cheng frowned slightly: "Have you met Yun Jun?"
"I've seen it before." Qin Jue said lightly.
Xie Cheng's face changed slightly: "Then how could you still be alive?"
"You answer my question, and I will answer your question!" Qin Jue said coldly.
Xie Cheng snorted: "Yes, I want to kill you because you have a marriage contract with Yuan'er! Now she is married and has a distinguished status. As a father, I naturally don't want you, a person who may cause her trouble, to continue to live in the world!"
Qin Jue nodded and said, "Since you despise my life so much, no wonder I'm cruel."
Buzz!
Qin Jue waved his right hand, and the corpses of Xie Yunjun and the Xie family's masters all fell in front of the gate of Xie's mansion.
When Xie Cheng saw the corpse on the ground, his face suddenly turned pale, his pupils trembled, and he exclaimed: "Jun'er!"
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 5 Anyone who wants to kill me will come out Volume 1 Chapter 6 No one can leave
